text:
jamal: Heads-up — SCIM jobs started failing for tenant=acmecorp after the RBAC role rename deploy at 08:58. Lots of decrypt errors.

petra: any sample error?

jamal: pasted from provisioner logs:
```2026-03-23T09:11:02Z ERROR provisioner.scim decrypt failed key=projects/redwood-kms/keys/identity tenant=acmecorp err=DecryptionFailure: encryption context mismatch (expected: role=eng_old, got: role=eng_new) object_id=usr-987 trace=tx-1a2b```

mira: ok that screams context-bound KMS encryption. We use role in the encryption context for attribute blobs. Role mapping changed during the rename, so old ciphertexts can't be decrypted with the new context.

alex: short fix: have provisioner try a fallback decrypt with the previous context(s) for a limited window and log the fallback usage. long fix: rewrap all affected blobs under the new context.

petra: agree. fallback should be feature-flagged + tenant-scoped so we don't silently alter behavior for everyone. Also we must emit audit events whenever we succeed with fallback or do a rewrap. Compliance will want evidence.

ops-bot: deploy request queued: patch/provisioner/fallback-decrypt -> staging. CI green.

alex: PR up, small change. It tries contexts [new, old] and logs which one worked. Flag name: provisioner.fallback_decrypt.<tenant>.

jamal: Any risk of exposing plaintext? we only decrypt to validate state and then re-encrypt when rewrap job runs, right?

petra: yes — flow is decrypt -> verify copy matches checksum -> re-encrypt under new context (rewrap). We never persist plaintext beyond ephemeral memory. Still, log redaction must be enforced.

mira: support side: pause automatic Okta retry window for acmecorp to avoid duplicate churn, and send CSM note explaining we're running a remedial rewrap.

idp-proxy-bot: role-mapping snapshot for tenant=acmecorp: {previous: "eng_old", current: "eng_new", changed_at: "2026-03-23T08:58:12Z"}

alex: staging deploy succeeded. Enabling flag for acmecorp only:```/admin/flags set provisioner.fallback_decrypt.acmecorp=true```

jamal: staging logs show ~9 users hit fallback and were re-enqueued for rewrap. Good sign.

sre-oncall: Note: enable will double KMS decrypt QPS for affected traffic. I've temporarily lowered the KMS alert threshold and will watch for throttling.

petra: drafting rewrap job plan — dry-run picks 50 objects across 3 tenants (acmecorp + 2 similar tenants). Steps: 1) snapshot object ids 2) dry-run decrypt+rewrap in staging copy 3) emit audit events to audit-log-stream/rewrap 4) verify SCIM provisioning success post-rewrap. Target EOD if dry-run clean.

mira: support message queued to AcmeCorp CSM. Template includes short cause, mitigation (fallback+rewrap), ETA, and apology. CSM asked for postmortem.

jamal: can we make rewrap idempotent and resumable? if it fails halfway we must not leave objects in inconsistent states.

alex: rewrap will be transactional per-object: write audit event before re-encrypt, perform re-encrypt, then write audit event success. Use retry/backoff per object. We'll also track job cursor so it can resume.

petra: ensure audit events include actor=system, job_id, tenant, object_id, old_context, new_context, timestamp. No PII in events.

ops-bot: staging->canary deploy for rewrap-runner queued.

mira: please also capture which exact RBAC mapping change caused this so we can add a safe rollout checklist for future renames.

jamal: Agreed. Add a pre-change task: rewrap existing blobs to the new context as part of the RBAC rename rollout, or run rename behind a maintenance window.

alex: I've pushed a debug flag to increase fallback logging for 1h. Will turn off after dry-run.

sre-oncall: KMS alert triggered once during initial enable but subsided. Will keep the pager window open for another 2 hours.

petra: running dry-run now on staging copy. Will post results when finished.

jamal: thanks team. Follow-ups: PR link (alex), rewrap plan (petra), support note (mira), KMS alert (sre-oncall). Ping me when dry-run completes. :thumbsup:
